column1: # Forever loot of Shadowfang Keep (map 33): the item rows (spec jvbastel/WOWAI#240, ticket #245). forever/generator
# writes each confirmed row into forever_item_template (world database). The drop and quest reward rows are in
# loot_shadowfang_keep.tsv. The layout of the loot files is in forever/REFRESH.md, "Dungeon loot".
# Never edit a generated file by hand.
# Sources, read 2026-10-31: the Forever client build 1.60.1.70685 (Item.db2: class, subclass and slot of each item;
# ItemSparse holds every row of this file in encrypted data) and Wowhead's Forever tooltip data
# notes/forever/wowhead-cache/item, read with forever/generator/tools/wowhead_tooltips.py). Only numbers and names.
# Stock values: the stock world database (item_template, creature_loot_template, reference_loot_template).
# Item ID block: 71300-71399. Next free item ID: 71310.
# Rows: the 19 stock boss drops with their Forever stats (all blue in Forever); the 7 new boss drops of Rethilgore,
# Baron Silverlaine, Commander Springvale, Odo the Blindwatcher, Fenrus the Devourer and Wolf Master Nandos; the new
# quest rewards of quests 1013 and 1098; the stock quest rewards of 1013, 1014, 1098 and 1740 with their Forever stats.
# Rugged Spaulders (5254) is a stock drop of Rethilgore (creature loot 3914, 100 %): it keeps that row and chance.
# No row: the stock world-style greens on the bosses (6575, 3193, 9792, 9773, 9816, 9794): random-property items whose
# Forever tooltip equals the stock item.
# Spell power: Forever splits "healing up to X and damage up to Y". 1.12 writes it as SpellPower Y (damage and
# healing) plus Healing X-Y. Forever bonus armor is added to `armor`, as in items.tsv.
# Columns (tab-separated). "-" in inventoryType, delay, damage, resistances, bonuses and equipSpells keeps the value
#   kind           stock: a changed stock item (entry = sourceItem, its own stock ID)
#                  item: a new item with a stock twin (sourceItem: the stock item whose row is copied)
#                  new: a new item with no stock twin: class, subclass and inventoryType from Item.db2; the
#                       generator copies the stock item of that class, subclass and slot nearest in item level
#   entry          the item ID: a stock ID (stock), else from the item ID block of this file
#   foreverItem    the item ID in the Forever client and on Wowhead
#   sourceItem     the stock item whose row is copied (stock, item), "-" for new
#   name, quality (poor, common, uncommon, rare, epic), itemLevel, requiredLevel, bonding (none, pickup, equip, use)
#   class, subclass  the item class and subclass (new), else "-"
#   inventoryType  the slot as a number (13 one-hand, 21 main hand, 26 ranged right, 16 back, ...), "-" keeps it
#   delay          the weapon speed in ms; damage: "<min>-<max>"; armor; resistances: "Fire 5, ..." or "none"
#   stats          the base stats: "Str 2, Spi 3" (Str, Agi, Sta, Int, Spi, Health, Mana)
#   bonuses        the other stats as stock equip spells (forever_gen/equip_stats.py): "SpellPower 11, Healing 22"
#   equipSpells    more stock equip spells by ID
#   displayId      a stock ItemDisplayInfo.dbc ID (it also gives the icon); "-" for new: the display of the copied item
#   foreverStats   the Forever stats as the source shows them
#   leftOut        the Forever stats and effects that 1.12 cannot show or that have no stock equip spell, "-" if none.
#   status         confirmed (the source shows it), unconfirmed or unreadable (the generator leaves the row out and
#   source         where the values come from: a Wowhead URL, or "client <build>"
#   date           the day the source was read, YYYY-MM-DD
